title: Wiggle Subsequence
description: Find the length of the longest subsequence in an array where the differences between successive elements strictly alternate between positive and negative.
pseudocode:
1: let up = 1, down = 1
2: for i from 1 to nums.length - 1:
3:   if nums[i] > nums[i-1]: up = down + 1
4:   else if nums[i] < nums[i-1]: down = up + 1
5: return max(up, down)

steps.note: Initialize up and down counters to 1 for nums=[1, 7, 4]
Start loop at index 1. Compare nums[1] (7) and nums[0] (1)
